newsitem.title: USA: Cleveland, Continental unveil airport expansion.
newsitem.headline: Cleveland, Continental unveil airport expansion.

text.p: Cleveland and Continental Airlines officials announced Wednesday a $120 million bond-financed expansion of Cleveland Hopkins International Airport.

The expansion, unveiled by Mayor Michael White and Continental Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Gordon Bethune at a Cleveland news conference, calls for a $80 million regional jet concourse for the Houston-based airlines' new ExpressJet service and other facility improvements.

The project will be financed with a combination of special revenue bonds Cleveland plans to issue and Continental will be solely responsible for paying off, and general airport revenue bonds, according to a joint news release from the city and the airline.
